description: This Java source file defines the HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for receiving MQTT messages from a HiveMQ broker and forwarding them to a message processor. It includes methods for creating actor props, retrieving message payloads, topics, QoS, and handling message acknowledgments, as well as applying enforcement filters based on message headers and topics.

classes.name: HiveMqtt3ConsumerActor
classes.description: An Akka actor for consuming MQTT 3 messages from HiveMQ broker and forwarding them to a message processing actor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for the actor with given connection parameters and MQTT specific config.

methods.name: getPublishMessageClass
methods.description: Returns the MQTT message class this actor handles, Mqtt3Publish.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload from the MQTT message.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Retrieves the topic string from the MQTT message.

methods.name: getQoS
methods.description: Retrieves the QoS level from the MQTT message.

methods.name: isRetain
methods.description: Checks if the MQTT message has the retain flag set.

methods.name: getEnforcementFilter
methods.description: Obtains an enforcement filter based on message headers and topic, if available.
